The '''High Council holomap room''', also known as '''Temple map room''', '''Map Room''', or simply '''star map room''', was a large domed room within the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]] of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] used to access and project maps of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic bodies]] from [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] to sector maps.

==History==
When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his apprentice [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were waiting to be summoned before the Council, they waited in the Planning Center, noting that Coruscant was glowing red, symbolizing the danger surrounding the upcoming [[Eriadu Trade Summit]] that would be attended by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]. As they waited for Master [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] to descend from the High Council Chamber, the pair chatted with Master [[Jorus C'baoth]] as Jinn reflected that it was from the Meditation Deck that he first truly saw Coruscant.<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

Many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were drawn to the Map Room in troubling times. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] went to the Map Room to reflect on his decision to not take the young [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on as an apprentice. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] came to Jinn and told him that Kenobi would make a good student, and that if Jinn refused to take him, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] might assign him someone regardless.<ref name="TRF" />

In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], [[Sheyf]] [[Tinté Vos]] of [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu]] and [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] addressed Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]], and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] from the holomap regarding a disturbance at a prison complex on Kiffex. Because of his [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] heritage, the representatives [[Mission to Kiffex|dispatched]] Jedi Vos to investigate this problem. Later it would be discovered by Master Windu and [[Caretaker of First Knowledge/Legends|Caretaker]] [[Astaal Vilbum]] that the problem was [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] wraiths attracted to the power of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Volfe Karkko]].

Following the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], particularly at times when his mind and spirit were troubled, would go into the chamber and, as a personal form of [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]],<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Final Showdown">''[[Jedi Quest: The Final Showdown]]''</ref> set a dozen maps to play simultaneously so that he could decipher the complex information of the galaxy's myriad [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]; his master, Obi-Wan Kenobi, to whom the spectacle was a confusing blur, could not imagine why someone would find peace during such an exercise.<ref name="LotJ">''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]''</ref> After the [[Jedi Temple Apprentice Tournament]] of [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Apprentice [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]] ventured up to the Map Room to seek solace. The previous user of the room had been studying the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Clone Wars)|Battle of Brentaal IV]], Malreaux set it to display the entire galaxy so that he could marvel at how the political contests of the time did not affect the bigger picture. When Master [[Maks Leem]] entered the room Malreaux revealed that he had already [[Farsight/Legends|foreseen]] the conversation and knew that Master Yoda wished to see him in the [[Halls of Healing]].<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>

At the close of the Clone Wars, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] was revealed to the High Council too late. Sidious, in his guise as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], ordered the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|siege]] of the Temple and the execution of every Jedi present. Led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] raided the Temple, ruining the ancient edifice. While a small [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] force maintained occupation of the Temple, the Map Room was left abandoned and unused. While occupied, the spy [[Eve Yarrow]] entered the Temple's Map Room and entered information into the room's systems knowing that Darth Vader would find the information and use it against a small contingent of anti-Imperials that she had mustered together. Soon after she had hidden the information, ex-Jedi [[Ferus Olin]] found it under the file on the [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]] and deleted the information.<ref name="LJR" />

The Temple would survive for much of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Council Tower which contained the Map Room leering over the surface of Coruscant for years. The structure was even re-inhabited briefly, as members of the [[New Jedi Order]] searched the destroyed complex for any information on the teachings of the Old Order.<ref name="BRS" /> It wasn't until several years later that the five towers of the Temple collapsed, the Council Tower completely destroyed, by the aftershock caused by the disaster with the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]''.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> The new Order would clear the rubble away and erect a [[Jedi Headquarters|small praxeum]] in its place on the roof of the Ziggurat;<ref name="Star Wars: Union">''[[Star Wars: Union]]''</ref> though this too would be lost during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>

When the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] reclaimed the world, [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] ordered the [[Reconstruction Authority]] to [[New Jedi Temple|rebuild]] the Temple as a gift for the great sacrifices made by the reformed Order against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. While the structure was rebuilt using blueprints of the old building, it is unknown if the Map Room was reconstructed or replaced within the High Council Tower.<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

Following the war the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] donated a [[New Jedi Temple|new Temple]] to the Order in thanks for their sacrifices during the conflict. When the [[Reconstruction Authority]] rebuilt the Temple nearly exactly as it had been, the Operations Planning Center was recreated in the same place as it had stood over a decade before. It would see increased use as the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]] began holding its meetings on Coruscant. During the [[Dark Nest Crisis]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] Skywalker and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were being held captive on [[Woteba]] by the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] after being accused of beginning the [[Fizz (acid)|Fizz]] plague that was killing off their people. From the Operations Planning Center, Masters [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] and [[Saba Sebatyne]], along with Jedi [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] met to discuss what action the Order should take. Joining by holoconference, Masters [[Kyp Durron]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], [[Kenth Hamner]] all suggest ways of freeing the Grand Master while the two [[Joiner]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Zekk]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] argued for peace between the Order and the [[Unu]] nest. Master Hamner exclude the Jedi attending by holocomm and only spoke to the Jedi present at the Temple when he advised that the [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Fifth Fleet]] was heading to take on the [[Gorog]] nest and that the Order should use the assault as a distraction to extract the Grand Master. The situation was made easier when a hologram of Master [[Cilghal]] from [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] announced that she had discovered the Fizz was really a strange nanotechnology built into the planet and was not sabotage by the mysterious Dark Nest.<ref name="DNII">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref>

==Layout and style==
The Map Room of the Jedi Temple was a domed rotunda located several hundred meters above the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|main entrance]] of the High Council Tower. The ceiling was veiled in a soft fabric and was held up by the pillars lining the walls. [[Holoprojector/Legends|Holoprojectors]] around the chamber created the three-dimensional maps that filled the room.<ref name="LJR" />

A control panel on the wall allowed visiting Jedi to select a planet, system, or sector from the databanks and the room would instantly display the maps, rendering three-dimensional images that revolved through the empty space. A soft voice would detail planetary geography, languages spoken, traditions, cultures, religions, affiliations, and other details that Jedi would memorize before leaving on missions. Devoid of furniture, Jedi sat on the floor or stood as the stars and planets spiraled over head.<ref name="LJR" />

Following the execution of Operation: Knightfall the chamber lay ruined; though the holoprojector still functioned. Most of the walls were half destroyed, while the floor was pitted with blasterfire. A large gash in the broken floor gave one a view of the atrium several stories below. The ceiling, equally shattered, was opened up to the great empty shaft that ran from the [[High Council holomap room|Operations Planning Center]] downward. Ferus Olin dropped through a hole in the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]] several stories up and plummeted through the ceiling of the Map Room following a [[Duel in the Jedi Temple (Ferus Olin)|duel]] in the uppermost chamber of the tower.<ref name="LJR" />
